title: Jubilant Chiapan Keto Burrito
description: A keto twist on the classic Mexican dish, featuring jubilant and chiapan as main attractions. This recipe is perfect for a low-carb diet.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together jubilant, chiapan, and beans.
Spoon the mixture onto the center of the burrito.
Fold the bottom half of the burrito up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the burrito up tightly.
Place the burrito on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the filling is heated through.
